project.goal: Provide a stable, flexible infrastructure substrate for the May agent system.
acceptance: Platform infrastructure changes are driven by concrete signals.
Shared project execution surfaces are reusable by multiple projects.
The project state is understandable from the task tree and runtime frame.
forbidden: Do not encode domain-project strategy inside generic platform handlers.
Do not let a worker decide project completion.

platform-runtime-contracts.goal: Keep runtime contracts explicit, typed, and reusable across project apps.
acceptance: Runtime boundaries distinguish platform mechanisms from project-owned behavior.
forbidden: Do not add a global project brain that owns domain strategy.

project-app-v2-runtime-contract-audit.goal: Audit the v2 project app contract after platform adoption and identify remaining runtime gaps.
acceptance: Lists contract gaps found while adopting platform.
Separates immediate fixes from future runtime work.
forbidden: Do not change runtime behavior without a concrete failing contract.

platform-event-session-task-execution.goal: Keep project planning, worker pickup, completion, and rollup event-native and observable.
acceptance: Task loops can be explained as event edges rather than hidden global control flow.
forbidden: Do not make workers own global project planning.

event-native-project-task-loops-review.goal: Review the event-native planner and worker loop contract against the current implementation.
acceptance: Explains which event edges are implemented, stubbed, or still manual.
Identifies the smallest next implementation task if the contract is incomplete.
forbidden: Do not conflate task execution with project planning.

platform-persistence-read-models.goal: Provide stable read models for projects, sessions, metrics, learning, and task state.
acceptance: Shared UI can read project task state without project-specific file parsing.
forbidden: Do not require the HTTP layer to understand domain-specific task meaning.

generic-project-task-read-model-hardenin.goal: Harden the generic /api/projects/tasks read model with schema validation and clearer error states.
acceptance: Malformed task trees report actionable errors.
Missing task trees remain a graceful empty state.
forbidden: Do not reject older projects merely because they have not adopted v2.

platform-web-ui-observability.goal: Make shared platform UI expose project execution state while leaving project-local UI domain-specific.
acceptance: Any project with tasks/tree.json can show shared Kanban and task tree.
Project-local /ui can focus on domain features.
forbidden: Do not bake aks-rp-e2e feature assumptions into the shared platform UI.

project-kanban-api-read-model.goal: Expose a generic project task-tree API for shared Kanban.
acceptance: /api/projects/tasks reads tasks/tree.json for any allowed project path.
Missing task trees return an available=false response instead of a hard UI failure.
forbidden: Do not parse project-specific domain artifacts in the generic task API.

shared-project-kanban-platform-ui.goal: Move generic project Kanban and task-tree projection into the shared platform web UI.
acceptance: Project detail has a Kanban tab.
Kanban loads through /api/projects/tasks.
The board shows lanes, current state, task cards, collapsible tree, and task details.
The UI handles projects without tasks/tree.json gracefully.
forbidden: Do not make this page AKS-specific.
Do not mutate task state from the first shared projection.

verification.reason: Kanban tab wired into project detail, static UI synced, TypeScript check passed, focused HTTP tests passed, and changed browser scripts parse.

shared-kanban-steering-actions-design.goal: Design shared steering actions for task comments, manual advance, and task review from the Kanban surface.
acceptance: Defines which actions are generic platform actions and which remain project-local.
Keeps mutation event-native through project actions/events.
forbidden: Do not let the UI directly rewrite tasks/tree.json.

platform-project-app-v2-adoption.goal: Adopt Project App V2 in the platform project and turn the adoption into a reusable migration pattern.
acceptance: Platform has an additive .app runtime control plane.
Platform has a canonical v2 task tree.
Design docs explain platform as the second adopter.
forbidden: Do not delete legacy files until review converges.

platform-v2-layout-migration.goal: Create the platform .app runtime control plane and canonical tasks/tree.json additively.
acceptance: .app/ exists and describes runtime state.
Legacy root files are preserved for audit.
tasks/tree.json is valid JSON and uses stable loop tasks instead of per-run root clutter.
forbidden: Do not move or delete legacy files during additive adoption.

verification.reason: Platform .app runtime frame, JSONL streams, workflow/archive notes, and canonical tasks/tree.json were added additively; legacy files were preserved.

platform-v2-second-adopter-rollup.goal: Review platform's v2 adoption result and capture what should change before a third project adopts the pattern.
acceptance: States what worked, what was weak, and what to change before wider adoption.
Identifies any design/doc follow-up tasks.
forbidden: Do not claim the pattern is reusable without testing the shared Kanban on at least platform and aks-rp-e2e task trees.

project-app-v2-adoption-playbook.goal: Write a concise adoption playbook for moving another project to Project App V2.
acceptance: Explains additive migration steps.
Separates runtime control-plane files from domain workspace decisions.
forbidden: Do not prescribe one domain folder layout for every project.

platform-build-test-release-hygiene.goal: Keep platform changes buildable, testable, and releasable without calendar-driven cleanup.
acceptance: Relevant checks are run for platform changes.
Generated UI copies are synchronized from source.
forbidden: Do not perform unrelated cleanup without a triggering migration or failing check.

verification.reason: Ran bun scripts/build-webui.ts, bun run check, bun test src/app/http/http-project-sections.test.ts, and node --check on changed browser scripts.

platform-v2-webui-build-and-check.goal: Build/sync the web UI and run focused platform checks for the shared Kanban and task API change.
acceptance: UI source is copied to generated and served UI directories.
TypeScript check or focused tests run, or failures are recorded exactly.
forbidden: Do not hide check failures by marking the migration complete.

platform-signal-intake-loop.goal: Repeatedly intake platform signals and convert real platform work into concrete tasks.
acceptance: Unread comments, failing platform metrics, and owner directives become concrete tasks.
No-signal states are recorded as loop runs, not as new root tasks.
forbidden: Do not create duplicate root replan tasks for each signal-intake run.
